component.name: Text
component.description: A text element for body copy, supporting metadata and non-interactive labels.

useWhen: Rendering body copy, descriptions, or explanatory prose
Rendering UI labels that are not interactive (use Button for clickable labels)
Rendering supporting metadata such as timestamps, counts, or secondary context

notFor.case: Using Text for page headings or section titles
notFor.because: Text is sized for body content. Heading sizes start at title-small.
notFor.note: Use Heading with size title-small, subheader, headline, headline-serif, or display

useWhen.body-small: Secondary body text and sidebar content.
useWhen.metadata: Supporting details next to content: timestamps, counts, durations.
useWhen.label: Labels for form fields and controls. Bold.
useWhen.inherit: A span inside a Heading or other styled text that only changes color; typography comes from the parent.

useWhen.default: Body text on the page's default surface.
useWhen.brand: A word or phrase that needs accent emphasis. Brand color.
useWhen.disabled: Text in a disabled or inactive control or row.
useWhen.inverted: Body text on an inverted (dark) surface, such as a CTA banner or footer.
useWhen.inverted-subtle: Secondary text and metadata on an inverted (dark) surface.
useWhen.accent-inverted: Accent emphasis on an inverted (dark) surface.

donts.case: Nesting Text as="span" inside a Heading to recolor part of the heading text
donts.because: Every Text size option other than inherit sets its own font-family/font-size/font-weight/line-height, which overrides the Heading's typography instead of just changing color.
donts.instead: Pass size="inherit" so the span only changes color and inherits typography from the Heading.
